Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
# Display Characters

Rohan wants a magic board, which displays a character for a corresponding number for his science exhibition. Help him to develop such application. 

For example when the digits 65,66,67,68 are entered, the alphabet ABCD are to be displayed.

[Assume the number of inputs should be always 4 ]

> Sample Input 1:

    Enter the digits:
    65
    66
    67
    68

> Sample Output 1:

    65-A
    66-B
    67-C
    68-D


> Sample Input 2: 

    Enter the digits:
    115
    116
    101
    112


> Sample Output 2:

    115-s
    116-t
    101-e
    112-p
